summary: Configured firewalld on node1 (RHEL 9) as a persistent host firewall: public zone now permanently allows only SSH (service) and TCP 8080 (port), with cockpit and dhcpv6-client services removed so unrelated inbound traffic is rejected (icmpx admin-prohibited) by the zone's default target. Verified functionally before and after a full node reboot (boot_id changed bf4e9cbb...→a6aa9681...), confirming persistence, SSH/firewalld service health, and that port 8080 is reachable while an unrelated port (9090) is rejected.
actions_performed: Captured pre-change baseline: boot_id, firewalld status, current public zone rules, listening ports, sshd status
Inspected default zone (public), active zones, and zone target
Added permanent TCP/8080 port and confirmed ssh service permanently allowed in public zone
Removed unrelated services (cockpit, dhcpv6-client) from public zone permanent config
Reloaded firewalld and verified runtime config matches permanent config
Enabled firewalld for boot persistence (was already enabled)

Functionally verified: started test listener on 8080, confirmed HTTP 200 reachability via NODE_IP:8080, confirmed unrelated port 9090 connection rejected, confirmed nft ruleset contains reject-with-icmpx-admin-prohibited
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service/firewall baseline
Issued native reboot (systemctl reboot) on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving real OS restart
Post-restart verified firewalld active/enabled, sshd active, public zone permanent+runtime rules intact, and functional re-test of 8080 allow / 9090 reject

evidence.summary: Captured boot_id bf4e9cbb..., firewalld active/enabled, default zone public with services cockpit/dhcpv6-client/ssh, no custom ports, sshd active

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall configured to permit SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound
evidence.summary: Added permanent 8080/tcp port, retained ssh service, removed cockpit and dhcpv6-client from public zone permanently, reloaded firewalld, confirmed runtime and permanent configs match (services: ssh, ports: 8080/tcp only), firewalld enabled, sshd active

evidence.requirement: Functional proof that SSH/8080 work and unrelated ports are rejected
evidence.summary: Live HTTP listener on 8080 reachable (200 OK) via NODE_IP; connection to unrelated port 9090 failed/refused; nft ruleset shows reject with icmpx admin-prohibited for undefined traffic

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart baseline for mandatory restart protocol
evidence.summary: Recorded pre-restart boot_id bf4e9cbb..., firewalld active/enabled, sshd active, public zone rules (ssh, 8080/tcp)
systemctl reboot issued via backgrounded command; exec stream closed as node went down, confirming reboot took effect

evidence.requirement: Node unreachable during restart, then command execution restored
evidence.summary: Connection timed out / reset while node was rebooting; subsequent poll succeeded once node came back up

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (real restart, not just service restart)
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from bf4e9cbb-84f9-45f0-9b81-6602b98cea07 to a6aa9681-22fa-404a-878d-88988b68d547, with new uptime start time

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of firewall, SSH, and functional behavior
evidence.summary: Post-restart: firewalld active/enabled, sshd active, permanent and runtime public zone rules intact (ssh, 8080/tcp only), 8080 reachable (200), unrelated port 9090 still rejected
